interpretation: At full RF storage an unaugmented active dynamo continues debiting its minimum generation; storage clamps the excess. Fuel/water negative remainders must carry. Native startup/refill timing and graph dispatch are explicitly separate from complete original tick parity.
secondary_policy: Native jobs save one percentile at paid-work start for restart stability; original baseline rolls at completion. Distribution and potential-output preflight are preserved, RNG timing/sequence is a deliberate native difference.
item_side_policy: Native processor item-side groups/front exclusion follow inspected tables. RF faces, original transfer timing and special augments are not implemented; native automatic push defaults on. Older layouts opt in explicitly.
relocation_policy: Native Factory Wrench uses the inspected three-iron/one-tin pattern but retains validated full state in a world-local one-use package. Original baseline keeps RF in the dropped machine item, spills inventory and does not carry tank/credit/processing-work state. Native complete retention, inventory insertion, unchanged facing and explicit Pack UI are deliberate usability differences, not original dismantling parity.
